goal: FG-402: Fewer runs: promote shows why it refuses, --jobs, one parse per model file

components.summary: Runs model proofs, bound tests and the system root model.
responsibilities: run every model, system included, with known-bad and conformance checks
fail a model whose rule no known-bad variant breaks
read code facts for conformance and fail missing or unconsulted anchors
clean up model and pytest shard subprocesses in bounded time
run bound tests per item and require each to reach an anchor
print at most three open hazard hints per model
side_effects: runs one isolated pytest process per model when bound-test checking is requested
